messages:
lucas: quick handoff from Aquila-9B mixed-precision sweep (fp16/INT8/mixed-INT8+fp16 for long contexts) on GTN-compact slice. short notes for product & runtime.
anya: TL;DR?
lucas: TL;DR: mixed policy (INT8 by default, fp16 for long-contexts) gives most practical gains with small quality upside vs naive INT8. Pure INT8 cheapest but shows extraction regressions. fp16 best fidelity.
frank: unit costs?
lucas: cost per 1k tokens (incl batching & cache): fp16 $0.88, INT8 $0.44, mixed-policy effective $0.40 due to selective fp16 routing.
sara: quality deltas on GTN-compact (macroF1 vs fp16): INT8 -1.1pt, mixed -0.5pt. hallucination probe (n=1000): INT8 +1.3% abs, mixed +0.6%.
ci-bot: smoke tests pass. kvcache-drop: INT8 -3.7%, mixed -1.2%. quant-kernel-errors: 0.
anya: latency p95?
lucas: p95: fp16 180ms, INT8 190ms (+10ms), mixed 192ms (+12ms) because of selective fp16 fall-through.
frank: product wanted a single metric. I propose "TradeoffIndex" = 0.7*Quality_norm + 0.2*CostSavings_norm + 0.1*InvLatency_norm (higher better). CostSavings_norm scaled so more savings -> higher; Quality_norm = variant_quality / fp16_quality; InvLatency = fp16_latency / variant_latency.
lucas: snapshot:
```
Variant | Quality_norm | CostSavings_norm | InvLatency | TradeoffIndex
fp16    | 1.00         | 0.00             | 1.00       | 1.00
INT8    | 0.989        | 0.50             | 0.947      | 0.989*0.7 + 0.5*0.2 + 0.947*0.1 = 0.90
mixed   | 0.995        | 0.545            | 0.938      | = 0.94
```
anya: TradeoffIndex favors mixed policy. Product will want recommended default + an explicit quality_budget rule.
lucas: recommendation: default = mixed-policy (INT8 with fp16 for long/critical contexts). Fallback = fp16 for any request where signal `metadata.quality_budget < 0.9` or task=="extraction" or context_tokens>2500. Keep pure INT8 shadowed at 10% for low-risk pipelines; do NOT make it default.
sara: routing rule snippet:
`if metadata.quality_budget<0.9 or metadata.task=="extraction" or metadata.context_tokens>2500: model="fp16" elif metadata.traffic_tier=="bulk_low_risk": model="INT8" else: model="mixed_int8_fp16"`
frank: ops: canary plan - start mixed-policy at 6% (swap from fp16), ramp to 35% over 48h if no regression buckets. Shadow INT8 @10%. canary flag `feature.gtn.aquila9b.mixed_canary=0.06`.
ci-bot: scheduled re-eval job at 4187720000 to re-run post-canary.
anya: product blurb (2 lines) for GTN onboarding: "Recommend mixed INT8/fp16 policy for Aquila-9B to get near-INT8 costs while protecting long-context and extraction fidelity. Pure INT8 is cheaper but shows extraction regressions; keep it shadowed."
lucas: scorecard row: [Variant, CostPer1k, DeltaF1, p95_ms] -> mixed, $0.40, -0.5pt, +12ms; INT8, $0.44, -1.1pt, +10ms; fp16, $0.88, 0pt, baseline.
sara: follow-ups: 1) PR to gtn/docs with blurb + scorecard (anya) 2) runtime ticket to wire `quality_budget` signal to routing (assign frank) 3) 48h canary review (ci-bot).
frank: filing runtime ticket now. thanks team. :thumbsup:
anya: nice clean handoff. will add to onboarding playbook.
ci-bot: note: nightly stability run passes for mixed policy (summary attached in CI).
